title: Force and Laws of Motion — Samjha demonstration notes

inertia: An object resists a change in its state of rest or uniform straight-line motion.
An unbalanced external force changes velocity.
Mass is a measure of inertia.
newton_second_law: Net force equals rate of change of momentum.
Force is a vector; its SI unit is the newton.
newton_third_law: Interaction forces have equal magnitude and opposite direction.
The forces act on different objects, so they do not cancel on a single object.
